title: UK single release: Stand By Me by John Lennon | 1975
content:
John Lennon’s single ‘Stand By Me’ was released in the United Kingdom on 18 April 1975.

Its b-side was the non-album track ‘Move Over Ms L’, which was recorded during the Walls And Bridges album sessions.

A cover version of Ben E King’s 1961 classic, ‘Stand By Me’ was the only single to be issued from Lennon’s 1975 album Rock ‘N’ Roll.

The song was remixed for the single, with the addition of a synthesizer strings overdub recorded on 3 March. It was Lennon’s final hit before his five-year retreat from the music industry.

In the USA, ‘Stand By Me’ was released on 10 March 1975.
